announcements.headline: EQS-News: 1&1 Reports Nine-Months Figures 2026
announcements.insight: As Drillisch is a key competitor in the UK MVNO space, 1&1's nine-month results provide critical visibility into wholesale pricing pressures and churn dynamics within the broader telecoms sector. The data serves as a vital benchmark for assessing margin sustainability among smaller players facing similar infrastructure cost headwinds.
